newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ferry collides with tugboat in HK waters.
newsitem.headline: Ferry collides with tugboat in HK waters.

text.p: A ferry carrying 630 passengers was involved in a collision on Saturday with a tugboat in Hong Kong harbour, slightly injuring one passanegr, a ferry operator spokesman said.
Two people on the tugboat were rescued before it sank, said the spokeswoman from Hong Kong and Yaumatei Ferry Co Ltd said.
"The injured passenger was merely bruised after falling from a moveable deck chair... the other two (on the tugboat) were rescued and are perfectly safe," she said by telephone.
The ferry "Man Fat" had sailed from the southern island of Cheung Chau shortly before the collision with the tugboat "Tong Fat", the spokeswoman said.
A government statement said its marine department was investigating.
